platforms.name: NIAGADS Data Sharing Service (DSS) & ADSP Umbrella
platforms.summary: NIA-designated national genetics and genomics repository for Alzheimers disease and related dementias (ADRD). Hosts the Alzheimers Disease Sequencing Project (ADSP) Umbrella (NG00067) with whole-genome sequencing (WGS) and whole-exome sequencing (WES) across multi-ancestry cohorts, FAVOR functional annotations, and structural variant callsets.

platforms.name: NIAGADS Alzheimers Genomics Database (GenomicsDB)
platforms.summary: Public interactive knowledge base harmonizing >230 million ADSP variants, IGAP and multi-ancestry ADRD GWAS summary statistics, Linkage Disequilibrium regional plots, and functional genomic annotations.

platforms.name: Alzheimers Disease Variant Portal (ADVP) — Kuksa et al. (2022)
platforms.summary: Literature-curated catalog of >6,900 statistically significant genetic variant associations in ADRD across multi-ancestry populations, harmonized by disease risk, age-at-onset, cognitive resilience, CSF Abeta42/tau/p-tau181 biomarkers (NG00049), and neuropathological endophenotypes.

platforms.name: FILER: Functional Genomics Repository — Kuksa et al. (2022, Nucleic Acids Research)
platforms.summary: Giggle-indexed large-scale functional genomics repository containing >58,000 harmonized genomic annotation tracks (ENCODE, Roadmap Epigenomics, GTEx eQTL/sQTL, FANTOM5, brain cell-type ATAC-seq and ChIP-seq). Enables sub-second genomic interval overlap to colocalize non-coding AD GWAS variants (e.g., BIN1, PICALM, MS4A6A, CD33, CASS4, USP6NL) with microglia-specific active enhancers and PU.1 (SPI1) transcription factor cistromes (integrated with MiGA Microglia Genomic Atlas NG00105).

platforms.name: Genome Center for Alzheimers Disease (GCAD), VCPA Pipeline & Primary Tauopathy (PSP) WGS
platforms.summary: Coordinates joint calling of SNVs, INDELs, and structural variants (SVs) across ADSP WGS/WES via the VCPA (Variant Calling Pipeline and data management tool, Leung et al. 2019) and quality-control filtering (NG00126 Belloy et al. 2022). Includes primary 4R-tauopathy Progressive Supranuclear Palsy (PSP) WGS GWAS of SNVs/INDELs/SVs (NG00169 Farrell et al. 2024; NG00172 Wang et al. 2024), demonstrating the 17q21.31 MAPT H1/H2 ~900 kb paracentric inversion, exon 10 alternative splicing (4R vs 3R tau), STX6/MOBP/EIF2AK3/SLCO1A2 loci, and the APOE e2 risk reversal (APOE e2 is protective in AD but increases risk in PSP).
key_loci_and_variants: APOE e2 risk in PSP vs protective in AD

datasets.title: NG00049 CSF Summary Statistics Cruchaga et al. (2013)
datasets.study_description: Genome-wide association summary statistics for cerebrospinal fluid Ab42, total tau, and phosphorylated tau181 levels used as Alzheimers disease endophenotypes.

datasets.title: NG00052 CLU, a Potential Endophenotype for AD: Summary Statistics Deming et al. (2016)
datasets.study_description: GWAS summary statistics for plasma clusterin (CLU) levels analysed as an Alzheimers disease endophenotype in Knight ADRC participants.

datasets.title: NG00067 ADSP Umbrella
datasets.study_description: Umbrella dataset aggregating Alzheimers Disease Sequencing Project whole-exome and whole-genome sequence data, structural variants, and harmonized phenotypes across multiple cohorts.

datasets.title: NG00075 IGAP Rare Variant Summary Statistics Kunkle et al. (2019)
datasets.study_description: International Genomics of Alzheimers Project rare-variant Alzheimers disease GWAS meta-analysis, providing p-value–only summary statistics for case–control association tests.

datasets.title: NG00100 Novel Alzheimer Disease Risk Loci and Pathways in African American Individuals Kunkle et al. (2021)
datasets.study_description: Genome-wide association meta-analysis of Alzheimers disease risk in African American individuals using the African Genome Resources reference panel, with p-value–only summary statistics.

datasets.title: NG00102 Genomic Atlas of the Proteome from Brain, CSF and Plasma
datasets.study_description: Multi-tissue proteogenomic atlas linking genetic variation to protein abundance in brain, cerebrospinal fluid, and plasma, providing pQTL summary statistics for neurological and neurodegenerative traits.

datasets.title: NG00103 RBFOX1 and Brain Amyloidosis in Early and Preclinical AD
datasets.study_description: Genome-wide association analyses of common variants in RBFOX1 and related loci with brain amyloid burden in early and preclinical Alzheimers disease cohorts.

datasets.title: NG00105 MiGA Microglia Genomic Atlas
datasets.study_description: Genetic and transcriptomic atlas of human microglia across multiple brain regions and disease states, providing QTL summary statistics and derived measures relevant to neurodegenerative disease risk.

datasets.title: NG00118 AMP-AD Structural Variant WGS and SV-xQTL
datasets.study_description: Structural variant calls from Alzheimers Disease Sequencing Project whole-genome sequencing and associated SV–xQTL analyses across AMP-AD multi-omic cohorts.

datasets.title: NG00126 Removing Variant-Level Artifacts in ADSP Sequencing Data Belloy et al. (2022)
datasets.study_description: Variant-level quality-control filters and artifact metrics for ADSP sequence data, enabling artifact-aware association analyses and cleaner GWAS summary statistics.

datasets.title: NG00133 Safety and Pharmacokinetics of a Highly Bioavailable Resveratrol Preparation (JOTROL™)
datasets.study_description: Phase 1 trial evaluating the safety, tolerability, and pharmacokinetics of a highly bioavailable resveratrol formulation (JOTROL) with relevance to neurodegenerative indications.

datasets.title: NG00148 Rare Variant Aggregation Analyses in the ADSP Discovery Case–Control Sample
datasets.study_description: Gene-based and region-based rare-variant aggregation testing results from the ADSP discovery case–control whole-exome and whole-genome sequencing sample.

datasets.title: NG00156 Genetic Variants and Functional Pathways Associated with Resilience to Alzheimers Disease
datasets.study_description: Genome-wide association and pathway analyses of individuals with Alzheimers neuropathology but preserved cognition, identifying genetic variants and pathways associated with resilience.

datasets.title: NG00157 Sex-Specific Genetic Predictors of Alzheimers Disease Biomarkers Deming et al. (2018)
datasets.study_description: Sex-stratified and SNPxsex interaction GWAS of CSF Ab42 and tau biomarkers across seven cognitive aging cohorts, with p-value–only summary statistics for sex-specific effects.

datasets.title: NG00158 Sex Differences in the Genetic Predictors of Alzheimers Pathology Dumitrescu et al. (2019)
datasets.study_description: Sex-stratified and interaction GWAS of harmonized autopsy-based Alzheimers neuropathology measures across six brain bank cohorts, with open-access p-value summary statistics.

datasets.title: NG00159 Longitudinal Change in Memory Performance as an Endophenotype for AD Archer et al. (2023)
datasets.study_description: Cross-ancestry GWAS of baseline memory performance and longitudinal memory decline using harmonized cognitive data from aging cohorts, providing p-value summary statistics for endophenotype-based AD genetics.

datasets.title: NG00160 Sex-Specific Genetic Architecture of Late-Life Memory Performance
datasets.study_description: Sex-stratified and interaction GWAS of baseline and longitudinal memory performance across ADSP cohorts, providing p-value summary statistics for memory and memory-slope traits.

datasets.title: NG00161 Sex Differences in the Genetic Architecture of Cognitive Resilience to Alzheimers Disease Eissman et al. (2022)
datasets.study_description: Sex-stratified and interaction GWAS of cognitive resilience phenotypes leveraging harmonized cognitive and pathology data, quantifying genetic influences on resilience to Alzheimers disease.

datasets.title: NG00165 CHARGE Association Results from the ADSP R1 WGS Data Set Wang et al. (2024)
datasets.study_description: Association results from applying CHARGE consortium methods to ADSP release 1 whole-genome sequencing data, providing summary statistics for Alzheimers disease and related traits.

datasets.title: NG00166 Association Results from the ADSP R3 17k WGS Data Set Lee et al. (2023)
datasets.study_description: Association results for common and rare variants from the ADSP R3 17k whole-genome sequencing dataset, including single-variant and aggregate tests across sub-populations.

datasets.title: NG00169 Progressive Supranuclear Palsy (PSP) Summary Statistics Farrell et al. (2024)
datasets.study_description: Genome-wide association summary statistics for progressive supranuclear palsy cases and controls, enabling downstream PSP and tauopathy genetic studies.

datasets.title: NG00172 GWAS Summary Statistics of SNVs/INDELs/SVs for Progressive Supranuclear Palsy (PSP) Wang et al. (2024)
datasets.study_description: Genome-wide association summary statistics for single nucleotide variants, indels, and structural variants associated with progressive supranuclear palsy in ADSP 30x WGS data.

datasets.title: NG00175 Targeted Proteomics of Core ATN Biomarkers in ADSP
datasets.study_description: Targeted proteomic measurements of amyloid, tau, and neurodegeneration-related plasma and CSF biomarkers within ADSP participants, with accompanying genetic association summary statistics.

datasets.title: NG00177 Multi-Omic Endophenotype GWAS in ADSP
datasets.study_description: Genome-wide association results for diverse molecular endophenotypes—proteomic, metabolomic, lipidomic, and other biomarkers—measured in ADSP and related cohorts.

datasets.title: NG00180 Four Large-Scale Plasma pQTL and mQTL Atlases
datasets.study_description: Plasma protein and metabolite QTL atlases in individuals of European and African ancestry, providing summary statistics for genetic effects on plasma proteomic and metabolomic traits; useful for ancestry-aware biomarker and causal inference analyses in AD-related contexts.

datasets.title: NG00182 Genetic Determinants of CSF and Plasma ATN Biomarkers in Multi-Ancestry Cohorts
datasets.study_description: Genome-wide association summary statistics for CSF and plasma ATN biomarkers across diverse ancestries, enabling multi-ancestry analyses of biomarker genetics and Alzheimers disease pathways.
